page.layout: One page of text, with a running head and page number at the top. Below the text, the word FINIS in spaced capitals. Below that, a woodcut ornament (decorative, not text).

main_text.p: in mundum eius continuandis: quae causa quidem promissionem
Dei de Cenobanca pollicitus, repetit, vt, vigesimo quarto.
Deinde adiungit, ipsa de corpore suo illud effecturo, vt eodem corpore suo illos edocere promissionem
Dei, & ob ipsam gratiam illi ad remedio-

page.notes: The text is small and partly faded, especially the first lines and the verse-like short lines near the middle, so many words are doubtful. The line beginning "[illegible]" and the lines marked [?] could not be read reliably. The page number "45" at the top right is uncertain. The woodcut ornament below FINIS is decorative and not transcribed.
